title: Troubleshoot Too Many AGVs Directed to Hospital (Tipper Fault Beacon, Upstream Tipper Tote Count, E-stop)
summary: When too many AGVs are being directed to the hospital, check for a tipper fault using the operator station fault beacon and correct it, then return the tipper to service. If upstream behavior is suspected, check each tipper’s tote sending to the Hospital Station; if at least five totes have been continuously sent, push E-STOP, call a supervisor, and investigate/correct why totes are being directed to the hospital station.
when_to_use: Use when the system is directing too many AGVs to the hospital and the corrective actions are to (1) clear a tipper fault indicated by the operator station fault beacon and return the tipper to service, and/or (2) identify upstream tote sending behavior to the Hospital Station and escalate with E-STOP when at least five totes are continuously sent.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute troubleshooting steps on the operator station and coordinate physical checks at each tipper; initiate E-STOP and supervisor escalation when the continuous tote-sending threshold is met.
safety_notes: If the upstream condition is confirmed as continuously sending at least five totes to the hospital station, push E-STOP and call a supervisor (per troubleshooting corrective action).
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to each tipper to check tote sending behavior
E-STOP (push) and ability to call a supervisor

visual_references.description: Operator Station HMI Data Screen (VISU_DATA) showing the 'Tipper Stats' section including 'Totes Processed' and 'Totes sent to the Hospital Station' plus fault counts for left/right tippers.
Operator Station HMI Alarms Screen (Visu_Alarm) listing tipper alarms with timestamps and a SHOW HISTORY button (useful for reviewing tipper alarms while troubleshooting).

steps.title: Check operator station fault beacon for a tipper fault
steps.purpose: Identify whether the excessive hospital-directed AGVs are caused by a tipper fault indicated at the operator station.
steps.instruction: On the operator station, visually check the fault beacon for an indication of a tipper fault.
steps.expected_result: A tipper fault indication is observed on the operator station fault beacon (or no tipper fault indication is observed).
steps.healthy_condition: The fault beacon does not indicate a tipper fault when the system is not experiencing a tipper-fault condition.
steps.failure_condition: The fault beacon indicates a tipper fault while too many AGVs are being directed to the hospital.

actions.label: Visual check fault beacon
actions.exact_action: Look for fault beacon on the operator station.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Too many AGVs being directed to the hospital: Tipper fault - Look for fault beacon on the operator station. Correct the fault. Return the tipper to service.

steps.title: Correct the tipper fault and return the tipper to service
steps.purpose: Clear the identified tipper fault so hospital-directed AGVs stop being generated by the faulty tipper condition.
steps.instruction: If the fault beacon indicates a tipper fault, correct the fault and return the tipper to service.
steps.expected_result: The tipper fault condition is corrected and the tipper is returned to service (so the excessive hospital-directed behavior is addressed).
steps.healthy_condition: The tipper fault condition is no longer present after correction and the system is no longer exhibiting the excessive hospital-directed AGV condition.
steps.failure_condition: The tipper fault remains present (fault beacon still indicates fault) and too many AGVs continue to be directed to the hospital.

actions.label: Correct fault and return to service
actions.exact_action: Correct the fault. Return the tipper to service.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Tipper fault - Look for fault beacon on the operator station. Correct the fault. Return the tipper to service.

steps.title: Check each tipper’s tote sending behavior to the hospital
steps.purpose: Determine whether upstream behavior is continuously sending totes to the Hospital Station, which can drive too many AGVs to the hospital.
steps.instruction: If upstream issues are suspected, go to each tipper and check how many totes are being sent to the Hospital Station.
steps.expected_result: For each tipper, you can determine the tote sending behavior to the Hospital Station (including whether it is continuously sending totes).
steps.healthy_condition: Totes are not continuously being sent to the Hospital Station at an excessive rate.
steps.failure_condition: One or more tippers are continuously sending totes to the Hospital Station.

actions.label: Inspect tote sending behavior
actions.exact_action: Go to each tipper and check how many totes are being sent to the hospital.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Upstream issues - Go to each tipper and check how many totes are being sent to the hospital.
Figure 4-20: 'Tipper Stats' includes 'Totes Processed' and 'Totes sent to the Hospital Station' (left/right) and 'Faults' counts (left/right).

steps.title: Determine whether at least five totes have been continuously sent to the hospital station
steps.purpose: Apply the escalation threshold for upstream tote sending behavior that drives too many AGVs to the hospital.
steps.instruction: Using the tote sending behavior you observed for each tipper, determine whether at least five totes have been continuously sent to the Hospital Station.
steps.expected_result: You determine whether the continuous tote-sending threshold (>= 5 continuously sent totes) is met.
steps.healthy_condition: The threshold is not met (fewer than five totes continuously sent to the Hospital Station).
steps.failure_condition: The threshold is met (at least five totes continuously sent to the Hospital Station).

actions.label: Apply threshold check
actions.exact_action: If at least five totes have been continuously sent to the hospital station...

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: If at least five totes have been continuously sent to the hospital station: 1. Push E-STOP. 2. Call a supervisor. 3. Investigate and correct the reason totes are being directed to the hospital station.

steps.title: Push E-STOP when the continuous tote-sending threshold is met
steps.purpose: Stop the system behavior when upstream conditions are continuously sending at least five totes to the hospital station.
steps.instruction: If at least five totes have been continuously sent to the Hospital Station, push E-STOP.
steps.expected_result: E-STOP is pushed in response to the confirmed continuous tote-sending threshold.
steps.healthy_condition: E-STOP is pushed only when the threshold condition is met.
steps.failure_condition: E-STOP is not pushed despite the threshold condition being met, or E-STOP is pushed without meeting the threshold condition.
stop_or_escalate_if: If at least five totes have been continuously sent to the hospital station, proceed to supervisor escalation after pushing E-STOP.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: If at least five totes have been continuously sent to the hospital station: 1. Push E-STOP.

steps.title: Call a supervisor after pushing E-STOP
steps.purpose: Ensure escalation for deeper troubleshooting when the upstream condition is confirmed.
steps.instruction: After pushing E-STOP, call a supervisor.
steps.expected_result: A supervisor is contacted/escalated following the E-STOP action.
steps.healthy_condition: Supervisor escalation occurs promptly after E-STOP when the threshold condition is met.
steps.failure_condition: No supervisor escalation occurs after E-STOP when the threshold condition is met.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: If at least five totes have been continuously sent to the hospital station: 2. Call a supervisor.

steps.title: Investigate and correct why totes are being directed to the hospital station
steps.purpose: Remove the upstream cause that is continuously directing totes to the hospital station, which in turn drives too many AGVs to the hospital.
steps.instruction: Investigate and correct the reason totes are being directed to the hospital station.
steps.expected_result: The upstream cause of continuous tote sending to the hospital station is identified and corrected.
steps.healthy_condition: After correction, tote sending to the Hospital Station is no longer continuously occurring at the problematic level (i.e., the excessive hospital-directed behavior is addressed).
steps.failure_condition: The upstream cause is not corrected and totes continue to be directed to the hospital station continuously.

actions.label: Investigate upstream cause
actions.exact_action: Investigate and correct the reason totes are being directed to the hospital station.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: If at least five totes have been continuously sent to the hospital station: 3. Investigate and correct the reason totes are being directed to the hospital station.

success_criteria: Tipper fault is corrected and the tipper is returned to service when the operator station fault beacon indicates a tipper fault.

If upstream behavior is confirmed (>= 5 continuously sent totes to the Hospital Station), E-STOP is pushed, a supervisor is called, and the upstream cause of totes being directed to the hospital station is corrected.
healthy_conditions: Operator station fault beacon does not indicate a tipper fault when the excessive hospital-directed condition is resolved.
Totes are not continuously being sent to the Hospital Station at the problematic threshold.
failure_conditions: Fault beacon continues to indicate a tipper fault after attempted correction.
At least five totes continue to be continuously sent to the Hospital Station without successful correction of the upstream cause.
escalation_guidance: When at least five totes have been continuously sent to the hospital station: push E-STOP and call a supervisor, then investigate/correct the reason totes are being directed to the hospital station.

missing_details: The manual states to 'Look for fault beacon on the operator station' but the packet does not provide a specific artifact showing the fault beacon location/appearance; the candidate requested an image but none is included in the provided artifacts.

The manual instructs to 'go to each tipper and check how many totes are being sent to the hospital' but does not specify the exact live method/indicator for 'continuously sent' tote count at the tipper level; the VISU_DATA screen provides 'Totes sent to the Hospital Station' totals, but the packet does not define how to confirm 'continuously' from that display.
